case_title.quote: SATYA NARAYANA TIWARI AND ANR. V. STATE OF U.P.

number_of_accused.quote: Only the husband and mother-in-law of the deceased have been accused of the offences in question.

accused_gender.quote: husband and mother-in-law of the deceased
accused_gender.reason: One male and one female accused.

accused_occupation.reason: The accused's occupation is not established; the shop reference is only the defence witness's claim.

victim_age.quote: The deceased was aged about 24 years

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the husband and mother-in-law of the deceased

statutory_provisions.quote: ss. 304-B and 498-A IPC and s. 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act

weapon.quote: half burnt cloth around the neck with knot half burnt... Smell of kerosene was present

evidence_type.quote: this case is also based on circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial evidence with medical, recovery and oral testimony.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: by first strangulating her and then setting her afire, needed at least two persons

trial_court_outcome.quote: were acquitted by the trial court

high_court_outcome.quote: awarded life sentence under Section 304B IPC, 3 years rigorous imprisonment under Section 498A, and six months

offence_finally_established.quote: committed the offences under Sections 498-A and 304 B IPC and under Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act

imprisonment_type.quote: awarded life sentence under Section 304B IPC

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence, so no fixed years for the main sentence.

neutral_facts.quote: Ligature mark around the neck, 31x7 cms
neutral_facts.reason: Accurate facts and does not reveal the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: No formal severity classification is given.

attempt_completion.quote: death of the deceased Geeta was caused by strangulation and then by burning

physical_harm.quote: cause of death is suffocation with shock as a result of strangulation with simultaneous A/M burn

number_of_offences.quote: offences under Sections 498-A and 304 B IPC and under Section 4

premeditation_planning.quote: the crime was committed by the two accused with preplanning

motive.quote: demand of Maruti Car raised by the two accused after about six months of the marriage persisted

key_evidence_accepted.quote: established by satisfactory evidence adduced by the prosecution in the form of the testimony of Surya Kant Dixit PW 1 corroborated by Jaideo Awasthi PW 2

witness_credibility.quote: The interested testimony of DW 1 Vidushi also cannot be believed

post_offence_conduct.quote: Absconding by both of them after the incident cannot be termed to be normal conduct of innocent persons.

bail_history.quote: On 27.10.2005 this Court had granted bail to the appellants. Their bail bonds are cancelled.

legal_representation.quote: Indu Malhotra, Rajesh and Vivek Jain for the Appellants.

investigation_status.quote: after investigation a charge sheet was filed

procedural_irregularity.quote: no charge under Section 302 IPC was levelled
procedural_irregularity.reason: Both points are in the judgment.

appeal_history.quote: acquitted by the trial court but the High Court convicted them

prosecution_argument.reason: No State counsel argument is recorded in the judgment.

defence_argument.correct_value: 'Soon before' proximity test not met; suicide theory; alibi; alleged manipulation of post-mortem report and incompetent doctors; mother-in-law's phone call to the victim's parents.
defence_argument.quote: the contention for the accused is wholly unfounded... We also cannot accept the argument that the doctors were incompetent.
defence_argument.reason: Father's motive is not stated as an argument; post-mortem manipulation argument is omitted.

legal_principle_applied.quote: cruelty or harassment may not only be physical but also mental

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Balwant and another Vs. State of Punjab AIR 2005 SC 1504

sentencing_rationale.quote: death sentence should have been imposed in such a case, but since no charge under Section 302 IPC was levelled, we cannot do so

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: Crimes against women are not ordinary crimes... They are social crimes.

other_sentence_order.quote: They shall be taken into custody forthwith to serve out remaining period of sentence.
